game_title: Flowchart Lab · Find the larger number
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge, a ridge shrouded in ash: the ember mage must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Smoke Ridge open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge: a ridge shrouded in ash
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Read a and b. Display a when a is greater than b; otherwise display b. Test dataset 3: {'a': 8, 'b': 3}; {'a': -3, 'b': -5}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Modulo Gate' (Week 2 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Smoke Ridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Reach the magma valve using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The magma valve reached with actions_used <= 22.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the magma valve is reached, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
